---
title: "OSMnx · Save, export and cache"
---

::: {.lead}
Persist the network as GraphML, export it to GIS formats, and reuse downloads
through the cache. Mirrors the
[Import/Export panel](../../../panels/osmnx/io.qmd).
:::

Needs an active downloaded network ([Download a street network](download.qmd)).

## 1. Save and load GraphML

OSMnx's native format, and the only one here that preserves every attribute. Set
**GraphML Path**, then **Save GraphML** or **Load GraphML**.

![Saving the network to GraphML.](../../../assets/guides/osmnx/08-graphml.png)

## 2. Export to GIS formats

**GeoPackage** suits QGIS, **GraphML (Gephi)** suits network-analysis tools, and
**OSM XML** and **SVG** cover round-tripping and figures.

![Choosing an export format.](../../../assets/guides/osmnx/08-export.png)

## 3. Use the cache

**Save to Cache** stores the full graph object on disk so the same area never has
to be downloaded twice. **View Cached Graphs** lists what is there, **Load from
Cache** restores one instantly, **Open Cache Directory** reveals the folder.

![The graph cache controls.](../../../assets/guides/osmnx/08-cache.png)
